dct_description_sm: 3 bar scales on map, given in “Scales of Miles.”
Latitudinal and longitudinal lines along margins.
Shows topography, vegetation, waterways, shoals, routes.
Appears in Camden's Britannia, newly translated into English with large additions and improvements, publish'd by Edmund Gibson, London, 1695.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 174.
